title: OTECH SC-SC 5M Single-Mode Fiber Patch Cable

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Enhance your network performance with the OTECH SC-SC 5M Single-Mode Fiber Patch Cable, engineered for reliable high-speed data transmission.

This premium OS2 fiber optic cable ensures low insertion loss and high return loss, providing superior signal quality for long-distance connections. Ideal for data centers, telecom networks, and server rooms, it offers a robust and durable design for everyday use. The 5-meter length provides flexibility while maintaining a clean and organized setup. Trust OTECH BD for quality and performance in every connection.


Key Features:

  • Connector Type: SC-SC duplex connectors for secure, stable connections.
  • Fiber Type: Single-Mode OS2 (9/125 µm) for long-distance transmission.
  • Length: 5 meters – ideal for server rooms and networking setups.
  • Polish Type: UPC or APC connectors available for low return loss.
  • Durable Jacket: High-quality PVC or LSZH jacket for protection and flexibility.
  • Low Insertion Loss: Ensures high-speed, reliable data transmission.
  • Applications: Suitable for data centers, telecom networks, LAN, and FTTH installations.
  • Compliance: Manufactured to international fiber optic standards for performance and safety.
